title: Open4Gene peak-to-gene linkage — clean-room reimpl of hbliu/Open4Gene (Liu et al. Science 2025). Hurdle model (logit zero + zero-truncated NB count) linking snATAC peaks to snRNA genes across multiome cells, per cell type, with covariates. Subcommands: link. statsmodels-based; validated vs the R pscl::hurdle reference.

validation.scope_note: Benchmarks execute fixed command sequences with no model in the loop, so this establishes implementation correctness only — not that an agent would select this skill unaided. See Docs/EVALUATION.md.
